title: Tabaquite Heritage & Recreation Tour
summary: A full-day National Trust excursion pairs railway heritage, countryside scenery and a visit to Harry's Water Park.
description: The National Trust of Trinidad and Tobago is running a full-day Tabaquite tour on Saturday, October 3, 2026, from 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The itinerary includes Knolly's Tunnel and other railway heritage sites, the Low Dam viewpoint, a community school garden and farm, and bathing time at Harry's Water Park. The listed non-member price is TT$400 with lunch included; members pay TT$350. Confirm transport, meeting point and remaining spaces with the organizer before booking.
